nodes.label: 12 · Home — Inicio HTML Design Export
nodes.rationale: Self-contained static HTML export of two 1728x1080 app screens (Home and Proyectos) rendered side by side at 3616px width, using Tailwind CDN plus absolute-positioned flex trees and per-node data-pencil-name attributes so the export round-trips back into the design tool.

nodes.label: 12 · Home — Inicio (Home Screen)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard landing screen: greeting + primary CTA, a 'Continuar trabajando' rail of recent project cards, and an AI-suggested 'Plan para hoy' task list — answers 'what do I do today' rather than 'what exists'.

nodes.label: 13 · Proyectos — Vista general (Projects Overview Screen)
nodes.rationale: Full project catalog screen: title + subtitle + 'Nuevo proyecto' CTA, a filter/sort/search toolbar, and a 3-column card grid covering all lifecycle states (active, completed, archived) — the management counterpart to the Home screen's curated view.

nodes.label: App Shell Sidebar (52px Icon Rail)
nodes.rationale: Fixed 52px icon-only rail (bg #E7E7EA) reused identically by both screens: logo, section nav, a flex spacer, settings, then divider and account avatar pinned to the bottom.

nodes.label: Sidebar Navigation Items (Inicio / Proyectos / Tareas / Configuración)
nodes.rationale: 36x36 rounded-square nav targets; the active item is the only one filled with accent #007AFF while inactive icons are stroked in #6E6E73 — selection is signalled by fill, not by extra chrome.

nodes.label: Top Header Bar
nodes.rationale: 48px band (bg #EDEDF0) that holds a section-context chip on the left and a global search field on the right, separated by a flex spacer — the only chrome shared by every screen.

nodes.label: Section Context Chip
nodes.rationale: White pill with a tinted accent icon plus the section name ('Inicio' on the home frame, 'Proyectos' on the projects frame); it re-states the active sidebar destination next to the search field so the current context survives a collapsed icon rail.

nodes.label: Global Search Field (Buscar en modus…)
nodes.rationale: 190px outlined field in the header with a magnifier glyph and the placeholder 'Buscar en modus…' — names the product as modus and scopes search globally rather than per screen.

nodes.label: Ambient Glow Background Gradients
nodes.rationale: Design pattern: four 640px radial-gradient ellipses (blue #4D9BFF, violet #B37DF0, orange #FFB86B, cyan #5AC8FA, each at ~24% alpha) layered absolutely behind the content at staggered offsets and z-index 0-3, giving the flat #F2F2F4 canvas depth and colour identity without imagery; deliberately the same set on both screens so navigation does not shift the atmosphere.

nodes.label: Home Columns Layout Container
nodes.rationale: Layout pattern: a horizontal flex wrapper with a 20px gap that in this export holds a single flexible 'Main Column' (Continue-working rail stacked above the today-plan card), i.e. the multi-column dashboard layout is reserved but collapsed to one column.

nodes.label: Nuevo proyecto Primary Button
nodes.rationale: The single accent-coloured (#007AFF) button in both screens' page headers, with a plus glyph and identical label/padding — one creation entry point repeated verbatim so 'start something new' is never more than a glance away.

nodes.label: Continuar trabajando Section (Continue Working Rail)
nodes.rationale: Recency-oriented rail: a section header ('Continuar trabajando' + 'Ver todos' text link in accent blue) over a fixed 130px row of three equal-width project cards, capped at three so the rail stays scannable rather than becoming a second list.

nodes.label: Project Card
nodes.rationale: Core repeated object of the product: coloured icon tile + project name + overflow 'more' affordance, a one-line description, a progress row, and a meta/status row — the same anatomy is reused in the Home rail and in the Projects grid, with the grid variant adding collaborator avatars and hover actions.

nodes.label: Project Progress Bar (Track, Fill, Percent)
nodes.rationale: Track + fill + right-aligned percent label; fill width encodes completion (35%, 68%, 22%, 48%, 100%, 12% across the sample projects) so cards are comparable at a glance without opening them.

nodes.label: Card Meta Row (tareas · en progreso · última actividad)
nodes.rationale: Dense single line in the Home card combining 'n / m tareas', a coloured status dot with 'n en progreso', and a relative timestamp right-aligned by a flex spacer (e.g. 'hace 12 min', 'ayer', 'hace 3 días').

nodes.label: Card Status Row (estado + actualizado)
nodes.rationale: Projects-grid variant of the meta line: it splits the Home card's single row into a status block on the left (dot + 'n en progreso' / completed / archived) and an explicit 'Actualizado <relative time>' on the right.

nodes.label: Plan para hoy Section (Today Plan)
nodes.rationale: Tinted (#FAF8FE) header distinguishes the machine-suggested plan from user-authored content: sparkles glyph + 'Plan para hoy' + 'Sugerido por modus' chip + summary meta ('2 pendientes · ~1 h 30 min') + '1 completada' chip + a 'Generar nuevo plan' action, over a body of task rows. Progress is framed as a short, replenishable daily plan rather than an open backlog.

nodes.label: modus (AI Planning Assistant)
nodes.rationale: The assistant is surfaced as a violet sparkles glyph (#AF52DE) plus a 'Sugerido por modus' chip and a regenerate action, and the app's global search placeholder ('Buscar en modus…') uses the same name — suggestions are attributed to a named agent rather than presented as neutral app behaviour.

nodes.label: Generar nuevo plan Button
nodes.rationale: Secondary outlined action in the plan header that lets the user discard and re-request the generated daily plan, keeping the AI output revisable instead of authoritative.

nodes.label: Today Task Row
nodes.rationale: Three sibling rows with identical skeleton — checkbox (checked/unchecked), task text, project chip, then either a 'Completada' chip, a duration chip (~30 min, ~1 h) or nothing — so the list reads consistently whether a task is done, scheduled or open.

nodes.label: Project Chip (Dot + Project Name)
nodes.rationale: Tiny neutral chip (coloured dot + project name) attached to each plan task, carrying project identity into the cross-project daily view without leaving the Home screen.

nodes.label: Task State Chips (Completada / ~30 min / ~1 h)
nodes.rationale: Colour-coded micro-chips close each task row: green 'Completada' for finished work, neutral grey duration chips for estimated remaining effort — completion and effort use separate visual channels so the plan's remaining load stays readable.

nodes.label: Projects Header (Title + Subtitle + CTA)
nodes.rationale: 20px bold title 'Proyectos' plus the grey invite 'Organiza todo lo que estás construyendo.' with the shared accent CTA on the right — the same title/subtitle/action header idiom as the Home screen's greeting block.

nodes.label: Project Filter Tabs (Todos / Activos / Completados / Archivados)
nodes.rationale: Segmented pill control on a #F0F0F2 trough with 2px padding, defaulting to 'Todos'; lifecycle states are the primary axis of the catalog, matching the three card variants shown below (active, completed, archived).

nodes.label: Project Sort Control (Ordenar por: Última actividad)
nodes.rationale: Outlined dropdown-style control that shows the active criterion as a value next to a chevron, defaulting to 'Última actividad' — recency first, consistent with the Home rail's ordering.

nodes.label: Project Search Field (Buscar proyectos…)
nodes.rationale: Second, wider search input living in the toolbar and scoped to the catalog ('Buscar proyectos…'), while the header keeps the unscoped 'Buscar en modus…' field — scope is conveyed purely by placeholder copy.

nodes.label: Projects Grid (3-Column Rows with Spacers)
nodes.rationale: Card catalog built as flex rows of three cards with trailing 'Grid Spacer' divs keeping the empty slots of the last row, so partially filled rows preserve the column rhythm instead of stretching the remaining cards.

nodes.label: Card Hover Actions (Abrir proyecto)
nodes.rationale: A hidden-by-default 'Hover Actions' layer with an 'Abrir proyecto' button appears on the first grid card, keeping the resting card clean while giving the primary navigation affordance only when the pointer is committed to that card.

nodes.label: Archived Project Actions (Restaurar / Delete)
nodes.rationale: Archived cards trade the 'Abrir proyecto' affordance for 'Restaurar' plus a destructive trash button, i.e. archived projects expose recovery instead of entry — the action set encodes the item's lifecycle state.

nodes.label: Project State Chips (Completado / Archivado)
nodes.rationale: Chips placed beside the project name in the card's top row ('Completado' for Sistema de Becas at 100%, 'Archivado' for App de Recetas) — terminal states are labelled at the title level rather than in the meta line.

nodes.label: Collaborator Avatar Stack (AL, MG)
nodes.rationale: Overlapping initials circles (AL, MG) sit in the meta row of the grid card only, signalling shared ownership/team members without adding a separate member list.

nodes.label: Geist Typeface
nodes.rationale: Every text node declares the same stack Geist, system-ui, sans-serif, loaded as a variable font (weights 100-900) from Google Fonts; weight and size, not family changes, carry the hierarchy (20px bold titles, 13px semibold section names, 10-12.5px metadata).

nodes.label: Lucide Icon Set
nodes.rationale: Icons are inlined as SVG paths carrying data-icon-name / data-icon-set="lucide" (sparkles, house, folder, list-checks, settings, search, plus) at 13-17px in either grey #6E6E73, accent blue #007AFF or violet #AF52DE — colour, not icon choice, carries state.

nodes.label: Tailwind CDN Runtime with Preflight Disabled
nodes.rationale: Mechanism/decision: preflight is switched off (tailwind.config.corePlugins.preflight = false) and the export re-implements the reset it still needs itself (box-sizing on *, ::before, ::after; body margin 0), so the browser's CDN runtime cannot introduce base styles that would shift the pixel-exact design measurements.

nodes.label: Observatorio Regional (demo project)
nodes.rationale: Sample project 'Plataforma regional para gestión de investigación científica' at 35% (14/40 tareas, 3 en progreso, hace 12 min) — the recurring hero example used to demonstrate the active/in-progress card state on both screens, including the avatar stack AL/MG and hover action.

nodes.label: Portfolio permodusl (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Sitio permodusl y presentación de proyectos', 68% (17/25 tareas, 2 en progreso, ayer) — the late-stage active example, and the owner of the plan task 'Revisar responsive móvil' (~30 min).

nodes.label: Lista de Compras (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Aplicación móvil para crear listas de compras', 22% (5/23 tareas, 1 en progreso, hace 3 días) — the early-stage active example, and the owner of the plan task 'Implementar búsqueda de productos' (~1 h).

nodes.label: Red de Laboratorios (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Gestión compartida de equipos y muestras de laboratorio', 48% (12/25 tareas, 2 en progreso, hace 5 h) — appears only in the Proyectos grid, showing the grid surfaces work the Home rail omits.

nodes.label: Sistema de Becas (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Administración de convocatorias y postulaciones', 100% (31/31 tareas, 'Completado hace 2 semanas') — the completed-state card example backing the 'Completados' filter tab.

nodes.label: App de Recetas (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Recetario permodusl con modo cocina paso a paso', 12% (3/24 tareas, 'Archivado hace 1 mes') — the archived-state card example, deliberately shown at low progress to justify why it was set aside, and the only card exposing Restaurar/delete.
